decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The cited breaking-change item [ev-dea2079e5dc4] says the earlier Helm chart values enabled policy exceptions in all namespaces by default, and that 1.13 affects users who relied on that. The surrounding upgrade-guide section [ev-2bbc505de6bb] names the setting: users who want to keep configuring exceptions in all namespaces must set the Helm value `features.policyExceptions.namespace` to `*`. Together these give the subject (the Helm value `features.policyExceptions.namespace`), the change (its default is no longer `*`, meaning all namespaces) and the consequence (if the operator does nothing, exceptions are no longer allowed in all namespaces). The evidence does not give the exact new default value, but that does not block writing the subject; the CRD and Service diffs are unrelated.
